suchi.P02: The rain gauge on the white weather box is a short, wide bronze cylinder on a square stone block, exactly as in the reference sticker - not a thin tube, nothing like a thermometer.
suchi.P08: The leech is clearly a leech (flattened dark olive-brown body with a round sucker at each end), exactly as in the reference sticker - not an earthworm.
suchi.P09: The black snake's hair is solid spiky lemon-yellow anime hair, exactly as in the reference sticker - no flames, no fire aura, no orange or red.
suchi.P11: The mandarin is a small, slightly flattened tangerine with a short stem and a leaf, exactly as in the reference sticker - not a big round orange.
suchi.P12: The soft cap is clearly a knitted beanie HAT with a folded cuff, flipped upside down so its big pink eraser pompom points down onto the tall red flame - it must read as a hat, not a bowl, a funnel, a flower pot or an acorn. Only one eraser.
suchi.P16: The oil can is a small metal machine-oil can (flat round body, a long thin straight spout, a small thumb pump on top) standing on the bench and dripping from the spout tip - not a watering can: no carrying loop over the top, no sprinkler head, not floating in the air.
suchi.P17: Make the eyeglasses link clear: the abalone sits blinking with a bare face where its glasses were, and a dotted motion path runs from the abalone's face to the eyeglasses that land on the red magnet.
suchi.P18: The hardtack is a small stack of plain light-tan rectangular Korean hardtack crackers (geonppang), crisp hard biscuits each with two tiny pin holes - not a sponge, not cheese, not soap, not cake.
suchi.P20: Make the direction unmistakable: the gold bar is already halfway INSIDE the open safe, sliding in from the steamer side (motion lines point from the steamer into the safe), and the mantis pushes the safe door shut behind it.
suchi.P22: The rich man's powder puff sends a visible white powder cloud straight into the hippo's nostrils and the hippo sneezes. The wrestler is clearly a KOREAN SSIREUM wrestler, not a sumo wrestler: short cropped hair with no topknot, no sumo loincloth, a cloth satba belt wrapped around his waist and one thigh.

banwe.F1: The white dog is clearly a puppy DOG (floppy ears, round black nose, wagging tail, first-aid kit in its mouth), exactly as in the reference sticker - not a fox, not a wolf. Leave a clearly wider empty gap between the melon and the lady.
banwe.F2: Make it unmistakable that all FOUR roots come from the ONE cabinet at the far left: four separate yellow roots leave four different drawers of that cabinet and fan out, each reaching straight to its own target; no root starts from or passes through the stage, the flower or the jail.
banwe.F4: The green vomit clearly comes OUT of the fox's open mouth: the fox leans forward hugging its brazier and the stream starts at its mouth and arches away to the right. The bathhouse attendant is clearly a human man (head with hair, neck, shoulders, arms), exactly as in the reference sticker - not a block.
banwe.G1: Body direction is the key: in every pair BOTH characters turn away from the barricade between them - the left one shows its back to the barricade and faces the left edge of the picture, the right one shows its back to the barricade and faces the right edge; heads turned away, sulky 'not speaking' poses, arms crossed where they have arms. Objects without faces tilt away from the barricade. Nobody faces the viewer straight on and nobody looks toward its partner.
